cues.en: Hey, it's Bruno here.
cues.zh: 嗨，我是 Bruno。

cues.en: It looks like you have your computer all set up.
cues.zh: 看來電腦設好了。

cues.en: That's great to hear, because we have our first client.
cues.zh: 太好了，因為第一位客戶來了。

cues.en: They're a car manufacturer, and they have some data on cars that they need to figure out.
cues.zh: 他們是汽車製造商，有些汽車資料需要理解。

cues.en: But there's just too much mess out there.
cues.zh: 但資料太亂。

cues.en: They don't really understand how to read it.
cues.zh: 他們不懂怎麼讀。

cues.en: I heard you're good with data analysis, so I'm going to hand this off to you.
cues.zh: 聽說你擅長資料分析，所以交給你。

cues.en: Don't let me down.
cues.zh: 別讓我失望。

cues.en: This is your first task.
cues.zh: 這是第一個任務。

cues.en: I'll see you later.
cues.zh: 待會見。

cues.en: All right, everybody, there's another task that Bruno gave us.
cues.zh: 各位，Bruno 又交付任務。

cues.en: We have to analyze and do some data analysis on some car data.
cues.zh: 要分析一些汽車資料。

cues.en: Now, throughout the next couple of sections, we're actually going to get our hands dirty and start using Jupyter notebooks and start coding.
cues.zh: 接下來幾章正式動手，用 Notebook 開始寫程式。

cues.en: We're going to use Python, we're going to use Pandas, and we're also going to use something called NOM Pi.
cues.zh: 會用 Python、pandas，以及 NumPy。

cues.en: Now, a bit of a heads up here.
cues.zh: 先提醒一下。

cues.en: The way we've structured these sections is that you should code along with us, so make sure you have your Jupyter Notebook open and you code along and write stuff in as we have as well.
cues.zh: 章節設計成跟著寫程式，所以請開啟 Notebook，和我們一起輸入。

cues.en: We'll also provide all the notebooks and worksheets for you and at the very end of each section for
cues.zh: 也會提供所有 Notebook 與練習檔，每章最後，

cues.en: pandas and NumPy, we actually provide exercises based on what you've watched and what you've learned.
cues.zh: pandas 和 NumPy 都有根據所學內容設計的練習。

cues.en: So don't worry if you find some parts confusing because these are pretty tough topics to understand at first.
cues.zh: 有些地方難懂也別擔心，這些主題一開始確實不容易。

cues.en: But by coding along and then doing the exercises at the end of each section, you'll notice that things start to stick bit by bit.
cues.zh: 但跟著寫，再做章末練習，就會慢慢記住。

cues.en: Remember, we're learning these things because they're valuable.
cues.zh: 記得，我們學習，是因為它們有價值。

cues.en: They're skills that are valuable, and valuable skills don't necessarily mean skills that are easy.
cues.zh: 有價值的技能，不一定容易。

cues.en: If you can just watch videos from your couch and and not practice and become a data scientist, well, then everybody would be a data scientist and everybody would have high salaries.
cues.zh: 如果躺沙發看影片、不練習就能當資料科學家，那大家都能做，都有高薪。

cues.en: But that's not the case.
cues.zh: 但不是這樣。

cues.en: We need to work and practice to really understand these things.
cues.zh: 必須努力與練習，才能真正理解。

cues.en: So just giving you a warning, if it becomes a little tough, intimidating at first, remember this,
cues.zh: 先提醒，起初有點困難或嚇人時，記得，

cues.en: every time something is difficult, that's what makes a skill valuable.
cues.zh: 困難正是讓技能有價值的原因。

cues.en: So practice with us as you code and also make sure you do the exercises at the end of each section because they'll help stick that information that we've learned in the videos.
cues.zh: 所以跟著寫，也完成章末練習，幫助記住影片所學。

cues.en: All right, enough talk.
cues.zh: 說得夠多了。

cues.en: We've got to figure out this car sales data.
cues.zh: 該分析汽車銷售資料。

cues.en: So let's get to it.
cues.zh: 開始吧。
